text: ἡ Κοάλα ἐξέρχεται ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας μετὰ τοῦ σάκκου.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
positioning: Koala steps through the open cottage doorway at center-right onto the cobblestone path, smiling toward the garden. Koala is facing the viewer and leaving the house.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child is worn on Koala’s back with the flap closed.
